messages:
anya: Heads-up — change window starts in 10m for release v3.14. Canary rollout will begin. I'll run the health sweep and post results here. Please watch SLO dashboards and call out any anomalies. :eyes:

deploy-bot: AUTO: kickoff canary group A -> 5% traffic. Running preflight checks: cpu_p95, route_5xx, embed_latency, kvcache_miss. Posting initial snapshot in 30s.

micah: saw a tiny p95 blip on embed-route during the smoke run earlier, used to be ~120ms now ~185ms in one sample. not critical yet but tagging.

observability-bot: SYNTHETIC: /health/gen returned 200 in 180ms (baseline 140ms).

ryan: ok — remind: our pause thresholds are `5xx >= 0.5%` OR `p95 increase >= 200ms over baseline` sustained 3m. If hit, we pause and either pin or roll back.

kevin-m: checking kvcache miss-rate and open connections. If miss-rate > 8% we may want to enable prefix caching override.

deploy-bot: LIVE: canary now at 12% after staged ramp. Health metrics streaming: `cpu_p95=64%`, `embed_p95=198ms`, `embed_5xx=0.12%`, `kv_miss=6.1%`. No auto-pause.

anya: thanks — micah/kevin, can you keep eyes on embed route and kvcache for the next 10m? I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth.

micah: watching. quick run command I'm using:
```
./scripts/run-slo-scan --window=5m --routes=embed,gen --thresholds='p95:200ms,5xx:0.5%' --output=summary
```

micah: summary from that run: `embed_p95=202ms`, `embed_5xx=0.14%` — that's right on the p95 threshold. single-minute spike, not sustained yet.

ryan: flagging — p95 touched threshold. Do we want to auto-pin traffic back to v3.13 for embed-route or hold canary for 5 more minutes? My vote: hold and increase sampling to get more signal.

anya: hold + extend canary 10m. don't pin yet. micah, run targeted perf profile (small load) on embed route to see if KV lookups spiking.

kevin-m: running profiler now. quick paste of tail of logs:
```
[2026-03-21T15:02:13Z] embed-service GET /v1/embed 200 180ms kv_miss=0.09
[2026-03-21T15:02:14Z] embed-service GET /v1/embed 200 220ms kv_miss=0.12
[2026-03-21T15:02:15Z] embed-service GET /v1/embed 502 0ms upstream_error
```

micah: the 502 looks like a transient upstream from the new model-worker during heavy mem-pressure. not widespread. 5xx still low overall.

observability-bot: ALERT (info): rolling sampling shows embed-route p95 deviation 65ms over baseline across 3 regions, not auto-pause level. See dashboard: https://internal.obsv/redwood/dash/embed-p95

anya: good catch on the worker mem-pressure. kevin, can you throttle the worker threadpool by 20% on canary nodes? That should reduce OOM churn. If that stabilizes within 5m we continue.

kevin-m: applied setting `worker.pool.size = floor(orig*0.8)` to canary tier. Confirming rollout to 4 nodes.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: canary hold extended +10m per request from anya. Traffic now steady at 12%.

micah: new perf probe after pool reduction: `embed_p95=160ms`, `embed_5xx=0.08%`, `kv_miss=6.3%`. Much better.

ryan: that's a nice signal. I'd leave canary running and let GA proceed after full ramp if stable for 5m. Also add a short-term alert to the release page: `if embed_p95 > 250ms OR 5xx > 0.6% for 3m -> pause`.

anya: agreed. I've updated the release notes to mention the temporary threadpool tuning we applied for canary and to revert on full rollout. Also pinned the canary config to v3.14-canary-20260321 to make changes auditable.

micah: creating a tiny smoke dashboard for ops watch: `/dashboards/create --template=release-watch --name='v3.14 embed watch' --routes=embed`

observability-bot: MONITOR: short-lived alert rule added for this thread: `embed_release_watch` (p95/5xx window 3m).

anya: final call — will continue ramp to 40% in 5m if no regressions. Please call out immediately if you see new 5xx clusters or p95 regressions.

kevin-m: noted. I'll keep an eye on kvcache and worker memory.

deploy-bot: PROGRESS: ramp to 40% started. Rolling nodes: 4 -> 16.

micah: quick note — I'm seeing sustained p95 at ~165ms now across samples, 5xx stable at 0.09%. Good to go from my side. :thumbsup:

ryan: concur. if anything spikes we pause and either pin embed-route to v3.13 or roll back. But current metrics look solid.

anya: thanks team. leaving this thread open for another 10m while GA completes. If no alerts, I'll close and mark as `deploy:succeeded` in the changeboard.

deploy-bot: FINAL STATUS (in 9m): rollout completed to 100% with the temporary pool tweak; no auto-pauses triggered. Marking thread for postmortem checklist entry. :white_check_mark:

anya: closing — canary held + tweak worked, no rollback. I added a follow-up task to revert the pool size on next maintenance window and to add a regression test for model-worker under mem pressure. Thanks all. :party:
